status: Ready for implementation under explicit underwriting priors; no Monte Carlo run or empirical distributions claimed.

horizon.clinical_timing: Revealed on product decision dates, with approval/commercial/access distinct.

uncertainty_register: inputs.json:parameters. Every parameter has value, bounds, units, denominator, period, status, source/translation and distribution proposal.
sampling_order: Choose market/commercial scenario or draw IR capture and joint XR cohort-capture factor; pool counts derived from population and fixed weights.
Choose one access-price package. Conversion, access delay and net-price fractions come from the same package. Do not independently choose four favorable endpoints.

Draw retention/dispensing/pricing residual assumptions only where the chosen prior is explicitly documented. Paid intensity is one parameter, not independently resampled PDC and persistence that were used to derive it.
Choose launch-date, geography route and structural cohort scenario. Keep their selected uncertainties separate from numerical rate uncertainty.
Draw shared clinical gate first; if it passes draw IR and XR conditional successes at marginalPoS/sharedPoS. Compute each state exactly once with no further PoS multiplier.

Run dated financials and funding. Clinical decisions may change costs. Avoid allowing future unknowable outcomes to set a predecision financing price; use a common predecision information set if replacing the fixed-price diagnostic financing assumption.

Select standalone or completed acquisition within the horizon, conditional on clinical/commercial state. Value shareholder consideration at target date. Never add the entire acquired value to standalone.
Aggregate per-share target outcomes, funding need, clinical states and commercial units; report conditional and unconditional distributions separately.

suggested_underwriting_priors.continuous: Triangular(min, working mode, max) is an optional transparent analyst prior for IR acquisition, population, dose intensity, mature retention and cost scale; not an empirical confidence distribution.
suggested_underwriting_priors.xr_capture: Draw a shared commercial factor on [-1,1] and map each XR origin rate linearly from working to its chosen low/high. This defines a scenario dependence, not an estimated numerical correlation; compare with independent origin draws as a sensitivity.
suggested_underwriting_priors.retention: First-year XR working value is the user-selected efficacy allowance, at the upper end of its61-69.45%scenario range. Do not add AE benefit or secretly recentre a symmetric distribution above it.
suggested_underwriting_priors.structural: Use discrete scenarios for re-entry, hazard decay, non-PHVS migration, foreign rights and generic-price cap. Weights are analyst choices; unassigned until recorded.
suggested_underwriting_priors.acquisition: Do not convert selected successful deals or anecdotal contact into a fitted beta prior. Show0/10/20/30%scenario probabilities; working standalone excludes acquisition. Conditional failed-program probability is0 for this asset-only branch.
suggested_underwriting_priors.clinical: Use categorical four-state weights from engine.clinical_weights; compare shared-gate, independent and perfect-positive alternatives.
suggested_underwriting_priors.timing: Use explicit discrete6month-delay scenarios, not a fabricated continuous regulator probability distribution.

controls: Fixed seed and recorded draw count; serial deterministic engine first.
Separate epistemic ranges from within-patient randomness: this aggregated model does not simulate individual attacks.
No arbitrary numeric correlation matrix. Shared scenario factors and conditional gates are documented.
No independently sampled derived WAC annualization, source-pool counts or net-price components already chosen by access package.
No second efficacy multiplier on prescribing and retention unless separately justified.
No second redosing haircut on claims dispensing.
Record chosen priors, mixture weights and effective constraints with output; no false precision from many draws.
Monte Carlo quantiles are conditional on priors, not market-estimated probability of a long/short return.
outputs: Expected12monthprice and median/quantiles labelled scenario distribution
